methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Dual Component (Math + ELA)
content: Problem: In Phase 2, students must learn both hard academic concepts (Math) and the language to explain them (ELA), which can cause cognitive overload if taught simultaneously.

Solution: Every session is strictly split. Part 1 (Math Component, 40 mins) focuses purely on the math operation, vocabulary, and logic using engaging detective stories. Part 2 (ELA Component, 80 mins) shifts to the grammatical structures (comparisons, sequencing) needed to explain the math step-by-step.

parts.title: PART 1: MATH COMPONENT
content: A. Math Reading Input: The Cave of Crystals

Detective Max is exploring a dark cave (hang động). He needs glowing crystals (pha lê) to unlock the magic door. Max finds 10 crystals on the ground. Suddenly, a giant cave bat swoops down! The bat takes away 3 crystals.
"Oh no!" says Max. "This is a subtraction problem. If I have 10 and the bat takes away 3, how many are left?"
He reads it: "Ten minus three equals seven."
He must subtract 3 from 10. The difference is 7. Max has 7 crystals left to unlock the door!
→ Memory trick: M-I-N-U-S: Math Is Not Usually Scary
→ Memory trick: S-U-B: Subtract Unwanted Blocks
→ Memory trick: TAKE: Thieves Always Keep Everything
a. The bat will _______________ away my toy.
b. If you _______________ away two, you have one.
→ Memory trick: L-E-F-T: Look Exactly For Those
→ Key Collocation: how many are left
→ Memory trick: D-I-F-F: Do It Fast Friend
a. The _______________ between ten and three is seven.

parts.title: PART 2: ELA COMPONENT
content: A. ELA Reading Input: The Rules of the Cave
To open the door, Max must explain the math rules. He looks at his crystals.
"Addition and subtraction are opposites," Max says. "When we add, the number gets bigger. When we subtract, the number gets smaller."
Max looks at the numbers 10 and 7. "Ten is bigger than seven. Seven is smaller than ten. Because the bat took some away, my final number is smaller."
The magic door hears his perfect English sentences. It slowly opens!
a. Hot is the _______________ of cold.
b. Subtraction is the _______________ of addition.

Max must cross a fast river. He needs to build a wooden bridge. He finds 25 logs. But the river is strong, and the water washes 8 logs away!
